title: Network dynamics of momentary affect states and future course of psychopathology in adolescents
limitations: - Sample is limited to twin participants, limiting generalizability; - Sample is predominantly Caucasian, limiting generalizability; - Study design assessed psychopathology only at two time points; - Analysis was conducted at the group level, not the individual level.
notes: The paper does not explicitly state whether the study was preregistered. The authors mention using a permutation test for statistical comparison, but do not state whether this was pre-registered. The code is declared available, but the data is not publicly available due to privacy concerns.
